#time benchmark
```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(plotthis)
  library(patchwork)
})

# Step 0. IO

out_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/runtime_benchmark"

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Step 1. Manual runtime records

runtime_timepoint <- tibble(
  benchmark = "timepoint_number",
  x_value = c(2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24),
  x_label = factor(
    as.character(x_value),
    levels = as.character(c(2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24))
  ),
  infer_cell_phase_min = c(1.11, 1.10, 1.11, 1.14, 1.14, 1.14),
  infer_gene_param_min = c(89.11, 129.23, 109.47, 93.85, 141.71, 84.71)
)

runtime_cellnumber <- tibble(
  benchmark = "cell_number",
  x_value = c(600, 1500, 3000, 6000, 10500, 20000),
  x_label = factor(
    c("600", "1,500", "3,000", "6,000", "10,500", "20,000"),
    levels = c("600", "1,500", "3,000", "6,000", "10,500", "20,000")
  ),
  infer_cell_phase_min = c(0.16, 0.20, 0.27, 0.42, 0.66, 1.11),
  infer_gene_param_min = c(3.50, 7.44, 13.81, 26.24, 45.01, 109.47)
)

runtime_all <- bind_rows(runtime_timepoint, runtime_cellnumber)

write_csv(
  runtime_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "runtime_benchmark_manual.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  runtime_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "runtime_benchmark_manual.rds")
)

print(runtime_all)

# Step 2. Plot helpers

COL_PHASE <- "#4F78A8"
COL_PARAM <- "#FFD84D"

save_plot_pdf_png <- function(p, filename_base, width = 4.8, height = 4.8) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(filename_base, ".pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(filename_base, ".png")),
    plot = p,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

theme_runtime <- function(x_angle = 0, x_hjust = 0.5) {
  theme_classic(base_family = "serif") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 24,
        family = "serif"
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 21,
        family = "serif",
        margin = margin(t = 8)
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 21,
        family = "serif",
        margin = margin(r = 8)
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 17,
        colour = "black",
        family = "serif",
        angle = x_angle,
        hjust = x_hjust
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 17,
        colour = "black",
        family = "serif"
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.85, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.85, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.18, "cm"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(10, 14, 10, 10)
    )
}

make_runtime_plot <- function(df, col_use, title_text, xlab_text, y_limit, y_breaks, x_angle = 0, x_hjust = 0.5) {
  LinePlot(
    df,
    x = "x_label",
    y = "runtime_min",
    add_bg = FALSE,
    pt_size = 4.8,
    pt_alpha = 1,
    line_width = 1.4,
    line_alpha = 1,
    palcolor = col_use,
    color_line_by_x_if_no_group = FALSE,
    fill_point_by_x_if_no_group = FALSE,
    theme = "theme_classic",
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    legend.position = "none",
    title = title_text,
    xlab = xlab_text,
    ylab = "Runtime (min)"
  ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      vjust = -0.85,
      size = 5.4,
      family = "serif",
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = y_limit,
      breaks = y_breaks,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
    ) +
    theme_runtime(x_angle = x_angle, x_hjust = x_hjust)
}

# Step 3. Build plotting tables

df_tp_phase <- runtime_timepoint %>%
  transmute(
    x_label,
    runtime_min = infer_cell_phase_min,
    label = sprintf("%.2f", runtime_min)
  )

df_cell_phase <- runtime_cellnumber %>%
  transmute(
    x_label,
    runtime_min = infer_cell_phase_min,
    label = sprintf("%.2f", runtime_min)
  )

df_tp_param <- runtime_timepoint %>%
  transmute(
    x_label,
    runtime_min = infer_gene_param_min,
    label = sprintf("%.1f", runtime_min)
  )

df_cell_param <- runtime_cellnumber %>%
  transmute(
    x_label,
    runtime_min = infer_gene_param_min,
    label = sprintf("%.1f", runtime_min)
  )

# Step 4. Draw panels

p_A <- make_runtime_plot(
  df = df_tp_phase,
  col_use = COL_PHASE,
  title_text = "infer_cell_phase",
  xlab_text = "Sample time points",
  y_limit = c(0, 1.45),
  y_breaks = seq(0, 1.4, by = 0.2)
)

p_B <- make_runtime_plot(
  df = df_cell_phase,
  col_use = COL_PHASE,
  title_text = "infer_cell_phase",
  xlab_text = "Cells",
  y_limit = c(0, 1.45),
  y_breaks = seq(0, 1.4, by = 0.2),
  x_angle = 30,
  x_hjust = 1
)

p_C <- make_runtime_plot(
  df = df_tp_param,
  col_use = COL_PARAM,
  title_text = "infer_gene_param",
  xlab_text = "Sample time points",
  y_limit = c(0, 165),
  y_breaks = seq(0, 160, by = 40)
)

p_D <- make_runtime_plot(
  df = df_cell_param,
  col_use = COL_PARAM,
  title_text = "infer_gene_param",
  xlab_text = "Cells",
  y_limit = c(0, 125),
  y_breaks = seq(0, 120, by = 30),
  x_angle = 30,
  x_hjust = 1
)

print(p_A)
print(p_B)
print(p_C)
print(p_D)

# Step 5. Save single panels

save_plot_pdf_png(p_A, "runtime_infer_cell_phase_timepoint")
save_plot_pdf_png(p_B, "runtime_infer_cell_phase_cellnumber")
save_plot_pdf_png(p_C, "runtime_infer_gene_param_timepoint")
save_plot_pdf_png(p_D, "runtime_infer_gene_param_cellnumber")

# Step 6. Save 2 x 2 combined figure

runtime_2x2 <- wrap_plots(
  p_A, p_B, p_C, p_D,
  ncol = 2
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "runtime_benchmark_2x2.pdf"),
  plot = runtime_2x2,
  width = 9.8,
  height = 9.6
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "runtime_benchmark_2x2.png"),
  plot = runtime_2x2,
  width = 9.8,
  height = 9.6,
  dpi = 300
)

message("Finished runtime benchmark plots.")
message("Output directory: ", out_dir)
```
